name: text2sql-schema-retriever-minilm
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (labelled contrastive, question/table pairs from the train split), same 22,713,216-byte safetensors and identical tensor set as the base. Recorded because the card prints a base row in the same retriever table, on 453 held-out test questions whose SQL templates never appear in training. The win is real but narrow in kind: retrieval ranking over a 12-table schema, not generative quality. Card also publishes the second recipe (in-batch MNRL) which makes top-3 coverage worse than base at 0.748 - only the contrastive one is recorded here. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-17.

benchmarks.name: All gold tables in top 3
benchmarks.config: Card '| retriever | recall@1 | recall@3 | all in top 1 | all in top 3 | all in top 5 | MRR |': 'fine-tuned, labelled contrastive' 0.963 vs 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2, off the shelf' 0.812 (x100). 453 test questions, SQL templates unseen in training, top-3 of a 12-table schema.

benchmarks.config: Same table, base 0.920 (x100). Per-table average, softer than all-in-top-3.
